sub_graphs.title: State Management: Transaction Snapshot System
sub_graphs.description: Models the nested transaction snapshot mechanism for atomic state changes with rollback capability

nodes.label: No Active Snapshots
nodes.description: State object has empty _snapshots list, no transactions in progress

nodes.label: Begin Transaction
nodes.description: Create snapshot of main_trie, storage_tries, and created_accounts set

nodes.label: Transaction Snapshot Active
nodes.description: One or more snapshots on stack, modifications can be rolled back

nodes.label: Commit Transaction
nodes.description: Pop snapshot from stack, clear created_accounts if outermost transaction

nodes.label: Transaction Committed
nodes.description: State changes are permanent (relative to outer snapshot)

nodes.label: Rollback Transaction
nodes.description: Restore main_trie and storage_tries from popped snapshot

nodes.label: Transaction Rolled Back
nodes.description: State restored to pre-transaction snapshot

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'modify_state' will 'destroy the account if the resulting account has nonce == 0, no code, and zero balance' but doesn't clarify if this applies in all contexts.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume automatic destruction applies universally when modify_state is used. Callers wanting to preserve empty accounts should use set_account directly.

ambiguities.text: The interaction between created_accounts tracking and rollback_transaction is not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume created_accounts set is part of snapshot state and is restored on rollback. Only commit_transaction() at outermost level clears created_accounts.

ambiguities.text: The specification states storage_root and state_root 'should only be called when state._snapshots is empty' but doesn't specify behavior if called during active transaction.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is an assertion that will fail if violated. Callers must ensure no snapshots are active before computing roots.

implicit_assumptions.description: The state management assumes callers properly pair begin_transaction/commit_transaction/rollback_transaction calls.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mismatched transaction calls could corrupt snapshot stack, leading to incorrect state restoration or memory leaks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The trie implementations (main_trie, storage_tries) are assumed to be copy-on-write for efficient snapshotting.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-copy-on-write tries would cause snapshots to share mutation, breaking rollback functionality.

implicit_assumptions.description: close_state() is assumed to be called when state is no longer needed to release resources.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Resource leaks (file descriptors, memory) if close_state is not called on database-backed implementations.

implicit_assumptions.description: get_storage_original assumes the first snapshot in the list represents pre-transaction state.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect gas calculations for SSTORE if snapshot ordering is violated.
